name: Auto Object Skins
description: Turn a level's block deco into ready-to-use custom objects

min-repeats.name: Minimum Repeats
min-repeats.description: How many times a block + deco combo has to appear in the level before it counts as a block set. Set to <cy>1</c> to grab every decorated block.

max-sets.name: Maximum Sets
max-sets.description: The most block sets to create from one level. The most common ones are kept.

attach-distance.name: Attach Distance
attach-distance.description: How far (in units, a block is <cy>30</c>) a decoration can stick out past a block's edge and still be counted as part of that block.

include-slopes.name: Include Slopes
include-slopes.description: Also make sets from decorated slopes, not just blocks.

strip-groups.name: Remove Group IDs
strip-groups.description: Remove group IDs and editor layers from the generated objects so they don't interfere with your triggers.
